function: UC7 - Request Amendment to Confirmed Booking

history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of Request Amendment to Confirmed Booking function.
features: UC7 is sent by the shipper to amend the booking after the actual booking has been generated. The data is received into the DCSA Temp 3 tables.

Because this event happens after the carrier booking request has been converted into an actual booking, the agency user cannot generate an actual booking for this use case. The user can only view the data from DCSA Booking Activity and apply the required amendments to the actual booking manually.
•	UC7 is an IN-event type, and it is received only after UC5 – Confirm Booking Request. No validations are needed on our side, since HQ validates it while receiving UC7.
•	HQ calls PKG_DCSA_INTERMEDIATE_PROCESS.PRC_CALL_INTERMEDIATE_PROCESS to pass the Temp 3 data.

•	A background job transfers the data into the interface process tables. The previous use case version is changed to HISTORY, this version is marked as CURRENT, and the current event is “AMENDMENT RECEIVED - Request amendment to confirmed booking”.
•	The agency user reviews the data and processes the required amendments into the actual booking manually.
•	The booking request must be converted into an actual booking.
•	UC5 – Confirm Booking Request must already be completed.
•	DCSA event current status is updated to AMENDMENT RECEIVED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_CURRENT_EVENT].
•	DCSA status keeps its previous status [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_STATUS].
•	DCSA amendment status is updated to AMENDMENT RECEIVED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_AMENDMENT_STATUS].
